reasoning: On the season so far the Knicks are the stronger team; with home court the Knicks start about 6 points better, in a game of about 217 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Hawks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Knicks win 64 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 191 and 239 total points.
